The '''Ingo system''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] of the [[Bortele Cluster/Legends|Bortele Cluster]] in the [[Bortele sector/Legends|Bortele sector]].

The star system had sixteen unremarkable [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] that gave the system and its main known planet its name: [[Ingo/Legends|Ingo]]. The planet Ingo, in the second orbit in the system, was orbited by six [[Moon/Legends|moons]]: [[Auren]], [[Meragon]], [[Gravaj]], [[Por Raton]], [[Terig]], and [[Drarn]]. Only the latter two moons had accommodated massive [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations after they had being purchased by the [[Tagge Mining Company|House of Tagge Mining Company]].<ref name="P170" />

This unremarkable backwater system become a little better known after the acclaimed victory of two of its inhabitants, [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] and [[Jord Dusat]] at the [[Boonta Speeder Race]] during the celebrations of the [[Boonta Eve/Legends|Boonta's Eve]] of [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].<ref name="P170" />
